title: More Easy Stuff
description: Finally, Gold is useful! This mod adds Hardened Gold tools (Efficiency XII speed + Netherite durability) and over 20+ types of Golden Food that grant Haste & Regeneration buffs. Essential for a fun survival experience. Requires NeoForge.
body:
# 🛠️ More Easy Stuff

**Finally making Gold useful in Minecraft!**

Are you tired of Gold Tools mining fast but breaking after just a few blocks? **More Easy Stuff** is a "Quality of Life" mod that bridges the gap between the speed of Gold and the durability of Netherite.

My goal is simple: **Make survival fun and remove the tedious parts of mining.**

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 1. Hardened Gold Set
I created a new material that combines the best properties of Gold and Netherite.
* **⚡ Insane Speed:** All tools have **Efficiency XII** by default. You will mine stone like it's butter.
* **🛡️ High Durability:** Over **2000 uses** (more than Netherite!).
* **⛏️ Power:** The Pickaxe can mine **Obsidian** and Ancient Debris instantly.
* **🔥 Enchantability:** Like vanilla gold, these items get the best enchantments easily.

### 2. Golden Food System
Stop eating boring steak! This mod adds over **20+ new Golden Food items** (Golden Bread, Golden Potato, etc.).
* **The Buffs:** Eating ANY golden food grants you **Haste** and **Regeneration**.
* **The Synergy:** Combine *Haste* with your *Hardened Gold Pickaxe* for an **Insta-Mine** experience.
* **Crafting:** Very cheap! Just surround vanilla food with **Gold Nuggets**.

---

## ⚙️ Recipes

The crafting is designed to be balanced for Survival mode.

* **Hardened Gold Ingot:** Combine **1x Gold Ingot** + **1x Iron Ingot** -> **2x Hardened Ingots**.
* **Tools & Armor:** Standard vanilla recipes, but using Hardened Gold Ingots.
* **Repairing:** You can repair all items in an Anvil using Hardened Gold Ingots.

---

## 📥 Installation

> ⚠️ **Requirement:** This mod requires **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.8.

1.  Download and install the latest **NeoForge** installer.
2.  Download the `More Easy Stuff` .jar file from the versions tab.
3.  Place the file into your `mods` folder.
4.  Enjoy!

---

### 💬 Feedback
This is my first public release! If you find any bugs or have ideas for new "Easy Stuff" to add, please leave a comment!
